INCIDENT TYPE:
PASSWORD SPRAYING

DESCRIPTION:
Password spraying is a technique where attackers attempt a small set of common passwords against a large number of user accounts.

THREAT FRAMEWORK:
- MITRE ATT&CK | T1110.003 | Password Spraying

INDICATORS:
- Authentication spikes
- One password used against many users
- Cloud login failures
- Multiple accounts targeted simultaneously

DETECTION RULES:
- Same password attempted across many accounts
- High-volume authentication anomalies

AFFECTED ASSETS:
- Active Directory
- Microsoft 365
- Cloud identity systems
title: PASSWORD SPRAYING
